## Reporting Vulnerabilities
If you discover a security vulnerability or issue in this repository such as exposed sensitive data, misconfigurations, or content that could cause harm. Please report it **immediately and responsibly**.  

**Do not report security issues publicly.**  
Instead, report privately by emailing [security@scriptkitty.cafe](mailto:security@scriptkitty.cafe), clearly describing the vulnerability.

## What to Include
When reporting a vulnerability, please include:  
- A detailed description of the issue  
- Affected files (include line numbers if possible)  
- Any recommendations  

## Response
All reports will be reviewed and addressed as quickly as possible. This is a community driven project, so response times may vary. Please allow up to a few weeks for a full response.  

## Scope
This repository **does not contain any credentials, keys, tokens, or personally identifiable information (PII)**. If you discover any such data, report it immediately.
